Once the person who posted the ad clicks "I've paid" and even posts proof, that takes away the ability for the other person to cancel and trigger an immediate refund to them. This gives them an opportunity to double dip and fuck off. Maybe that was their very first trade and they were just trying to screw someone over, so as soon as the one person clicks "I've paid," the other person can no longer cancel.

The amount of time that is required to wait is going to be based on the payment type. We really need to do our homework here and come up with some fairly accurate time frames for the payment method. When they are selecting the payment method in that very beginning screen when they're first doing their searches and they're selecting the currency and using the dropdown to pick the payment method, it should say right on there, and they should know ahead of time, that FYI this payment method can take up to 12 hours.

So, you would be required to wait a full 12 hours after the seller or buyer or whatever the person who posts the ad is in this example has clicked paid in order to give the payment method a fair opportunity to transfer to you. They have to be made aware of that, and we have to do our homework for finding out what that time frame is for the ones that we're offering.
